# path<TAB>function<TAB>call<TAB>reason
# Identical calls within a function share an entry; closures use their enclosing function.
cmd/hataori/daemon.go	sessionKey	.Remove	Removes only state/dashboard-session.key.new, the half-written session key, through the instance's os.Root, outside the workspaces.
internal/dashboard/passkeyfile.go	passkeyFile.save	.Remove	Removes only state/dashboard-passkeys.json.new, the half-written passkeys file, through the instance's os.Root, outside the workspaces.
docs/notes/sqlite-bench/main.go	run	os.RemoveAll	Removes only the benchmark directory freshly created by os.MkdirTemp, containing its disposable database.
internal/host/host.go	host.listen	os.Remove	Removes the stale host socket at the computed socket path in session state or the private socket directory, outside the workspace.
internal/host/host.go	host.removeSocket	os.Remove	Removes the host socket and its session-state pointer file; the private external socket directory is removed only when empty, never recursively.
internal/holder/host.go	Host.Reset	os.Remove	Removes only the ended host's status file in the session state directory before a resumed host is launched there, outside the workspace.
internal/wire/server.go	Listen	os.Remove	Removes only the control socket and its pointer file in instance metadata or the private socket directory, outside workspaces.
internal/workspace/remove.go	Remover.Purge	.RemoveAll	The one deletion of user data: removes only entries of <root>/trash/ whose name the removal made and whose time in that name is older than the configured retention, through an os.Root opened on trash/ so nothing outside it is reached; the entries got there only through Remover.Remove, after the proof of design section 4.6.
internal/core/close.go	Core.remove	.Remove	Calls core.Remover.Remove, which is workspace.Remover: it moves the workspace into trash only after the proof of design section 4.6; reached only from the Remove operation and the removal pass, and only for a closed thread.
internal/workspace/remove.go	checker.commits	os.RemoveAll	Removes only the scratch bare repository this check created under <root>/state/removal to fetch the remotes' refs into; it borrows the workspace's objects through alternates and nothing in the workspace is removed.
internal/workspace/mirror.go	Maker.mirror	os.RemoveAll	Removes only this call's freshly created temporary bare-clone directory under state/mirrors-tmp; after successful rename that temporary path no longer exists.
internal/agent/claudecode/statusline.go	handOn	os.Remove	Removes only the temporary file this call just created with os.CreateTemp beside the --last file in the session's state directory, after its write, close or rename failed.
internal/connect/connect.go	conn.connect	os.Remove	Runs on the person's own machine: removes only this host's control socket in connect's private run directory, which a master that was killed leaves, under the host's lock; no workspace is on this machine's paths.
internal/connect/connect.go	conn.forward	os.Remove	Runs on the person's own machine: removes only this host's forward socket in connect's private run directory, which a master that ended leaves, under the host's lock.
internal/connect/connect.go	conn.leftOver	os.Remove	Runs on the person's own machine: removes only the control, forward and request sockets of this host in connect's private run directory, after ending a left-over master, under the host's lock.
internal/connect/connect.go	conn.stop	os.Remove	Runs on the person's own machine: removes only this run's control and forward sockets in connect's private run directory, if ssh left them.
internal/connect/connect.go	remember	os.Remove	Runs on the person's own machine: removes only the temporary file this call just created with os.CreateTemp beside the remembered hosts, which the rename has already taken unless a step failed.
internal/plugin/run.go	Runner.once	os.Remove	Removes only files of this start in the daemon's own state/plugin-run/<id>/: the executable copy exec-<random> that prepare wrote, and its run-<run>.json once the run's group is killed or the start failed; outside the workspaces.
internal/plugin/leftover.go	Runner.leftovers	os.Remove	Removes only state/plugin-run/<id>/run-<run>.json, the record of an earlier run, once its processes were looked for, or when it cannot be read or is of another boot; outside the workspaces.
internal/plugin/run.go	Runner.prepare	os.Remove	Removes only the copies of earlier starts, state/plugin-run/<id>/exec-*, in the daemon's own directory for the plugin, outside the workspaces.
internal/plugin/run.go	writeNew	os.Remove	Removes only <path>.new, the half-written file of the executable copy or the settings in state/plugin-run/<id>/, outside the workspaces.
internal/agent/claudecode/plugin.go	Adapter.WritePlugin	os.Remove	Removes only its own temporary file next to a plugin file it failed to rename, in the plugin's directory under the instance root, outside every workspace.
internal/window/window.go	Listen	os.Remove	Removes the stale report socket at the computed socket path in the instance's state/windows directory or its private directory under /tmp, outside every workspace.
internal/window/window.go	Server.Close	os.Remove	Removes the private directory made for the report socket under /tmp only when it is empty, never recursively; it is never under a workspace.
internal/runner/takein.go	Runner.letGo	os.Remove	Removes only the taken-in.json note in the session's state directory when a take-in ends; the window's directory is never touched.
internal/runner/takein.go	writeAtomic	os.Remove	Removes only its own temporary file in the session's state directory after a rename that failed, outside every workspace.
internal/window/window.go	WriteRecord	os.Remove	Removes only its own temporary file in the private directory of take-in records next to the report socket, outside every workspace.
internal/window/window.go	RemoveRecord	os.Remove	Removes only one take-in record file in the private directory next to the report socket; the window and its directory are not touched.
internal/runner/takein.go	Runner.RemoveState	os.RemoveAll	Removes only a session's state directory under the instance's state/sessions, after checking that no host runs in it and that it is a directory, not a link: never a workspace, which for a thread taken in is the person's own.
internal/holder/tmux/started.go	Holder.Start	os.Remove	Removes only the status file an earlier run of the session's tmux window recorded, in the session's state directory, before the next run; never a workspace.
internal/holder/tmux/started.go	writePrivate	os.Remove	Removes only its own temporary file in the session's state directory after a rename that failed, outside every workspace.
internal/runner/held.go	Runner.endHeldLocked	os.Remove	Removes only the held.json note in the session's state directory once its tmux window has been let go; never a workspace.
internal/runner/held.go	Runner.startHeld	os.Remove	Removes only the status.json an earlier host or relay of the session recorded, in the session's state directory, before a new relay starts; never a workspace.
